g.text: Hardware Solder Jumpers • ADS1115 / DS2482 Address Selection • Power & Shield Routing
Default: Metal shield bridged to GND.
Action: Slice center trace to break ground loop
for single-point earth grounding at Hub.
Dual jumper selects AD1:AD0 address bits:
• Default: GND_2 bridged to system GND
• Slice trace to isolate secondary power ground
